current.category: AI, Machine Learning, and Economic Measurement
current.title: Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders
current.summary: Studies representation risk: different plausible pretrained image encoders applied to the same images can produce materially different downstream conclusions. The paper compares modern and legacy encoders across economic, medical, biological, and demographic tasks and studies representation selection, combination, robustness, uncertainty, computational cost, and a reproducible software framework.

current.category: AI, Machine Learning, and Economic Measurement
current.title: Images as Covariates: Incorporating Missing Information from Structured Data
current.summary: Asks when images add predictive information beyond an existing structured covariate set. It separates image-only predictability, overlap with structured covariates, and incremental predictive information, with applications to Toronto houses, Thoroughbred horses, and Ontario Google Scholar profiles.

current.title: Which Policy Works, and Where? Estimation and Inference for State-Level Treatment Effects in Difference-in-Differences
current.authors: Nichole Austin, Sunny R. Karim, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb
current.summary: Distinguishes aggregate from state-level and other sub-aggregate treatment effects, and studies inference for policy comparisons across jurisdictions, cohorts, periods, and policy types.

current.title: Improved Inference for CSDID Using the Cluster Jackknife
current.authors: Sunny R. Karim, Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, James G. MacKinnon, and Matthew D. Webb
current.summary: Develops cluster-jackknife inference for the Callaway-Sant'Anna difference-in-differences estimator and provides companion implementations in Stata and R.

current.title: Good Controls Gone Bad: Difference-in-Differences with Covariates
current.authors: Sunny Karim and Matthew D. Webb
current.summary: Studies identification with time-varying covariates and introduces the Intersection Difference-in-Differences (DID-INT) estimator.

current.title: Jackknife Inference with Two-Way Clustering
current.authors: James G. MacKinnon, Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb
current.summary: Develops jackknife variance estimators and inference methods for linear models with clustering in two dimensions.

current.title: Difference-in-Differences with Unpoolable Data
current.authors: Sunny Karim, Nichole Austin, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb
current.summary: Develops UN-DID methods for estimating treatment effects when data held in separate silos cannot be pooled.
